meta.title: Pyreon blog
meta.description: How Pyreon works and what it can do: components that run once, one codebase for the web and, experimentally, iOS and Android, and benchmarks you can run yourself.

hero.title: Notes from the people building Pyreon.
hero.lede: How the compiler and the runtime work, what each release changed, and the numbers behind the claims, losses included. Every post links the code it talks about.

upNext.title: Up next
upNext.text: Written and scheduled. Each post goes live on its date, in the RSS feed the same day.

empty.title: The first post is on its way.
empty.text: Posts are published on their date with the next daily deploy. Subscribe to the RSS feed and the first one reaches you the day it goes out.

subscribe.title: Get new posts
subscribe.text: Every post goes to the RSS feed in full, the day it is published. No tracking, nothing to unsubscribe from.
